headline: Brazilian Treasury Rates and US Dollar Fall Following US Midterms
summary: Brazilian local Treasury yields fell by 1 to 11 basis points, following declines in US interest rates and a weaker US dollar after the US midterm elections.
why: Emerging market local bond yields and currency exchange rates are highly sensitive to external global liquidity trends and US macroeconomic shifts.

impacts.name: US Dollar
impacts.why: A weaker global dollar index directly pulls down foreign exchange rates against emerging market currencies.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A drop in global dollar strength and lower external yields reduce domestic funding costs and currency pressures in emerging markets.
